# Funngro Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base

## Overview
Funngro is India's premier youth freelance and micro-opportunity platform connecting teens and young adults (ages 14-25) with top domestic and global brands. The platform empowers the next generation to gain real commercial experience, complete briefs, and earn their first independent income safely.

## Key Features & Value Propositions
1. Brand Campaigns: Direct promotional tasks from reputable enterprises.
2. Content Creation: User-generated content (UGC), short videos, product reviews, and blog articles.
3. Referrals: Curated app and service referrals with verified payouts upon milestone completion.
4. Micro-surveys: Consumer feedback and product research for recognized brands like Nielsen and Toluna.
5. SheLancer Community: A dedicated, moderated space specifically built for women and girls to earn with women-focused brand briefs and safe, supportive networks.
6. Transparent UPI Payments: Earnings are credited directly to UPI handles or bank accounts with zero platform deductions.

## Company Background
- Founders: Payal Jain (CEO) and Anik Jain (CFO)
- Founded: FY22 in Mumbai, India
- Shark Tank India: Featured on Shark Tank India Season 2, receiving investment backing from Amit Jain via SucSEED Indovation.
- Growth: Grew organically from MVP to over 7 million (70 Lakh) registered users and 5,000+ brands.

## Technical & Agentic Accessibility
- Primary Domain: https://funngro-revamped.vercel.app/
- Mobile Applications: Available on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
- Discoverability: ARD / WebMCP compliant agent manifest at /.well-known/ai-catalog.json.
